==English==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:af|video|game|tree=1}}
From {{compound|en|video|game|notext=1|type=endocentric}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈvɪdiːəʊ̯ˌɡeɪm/|nocount=1|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈvɪdioʊ̯ˌɡeɪm/|/ˈvɪdjoʊˌɡeɪm/|nocount=1|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Persent101-video game.wav|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪm|s=3}}
* {{hyphenation|en|vid|eo game}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}
[[Image:Universum TV Multispiel 2006.jpg|thumb|Children playing an early video game from 1978.]]

# {{senseid|en|Q7889}}A [[type#Noun|type]] of [[game#Noun|game]], [[exist]]ing as and [[control#Verb|controlled]] by [[software]], usually [[run#Verb|run]] by a [[video game console]] or a [[computer]], [[play#Verb|played]] on a [[monitor]] or [[television]] [[screen#Noun|screen]], and controlled by a [[joypad]], [[joystick]], [[keyboard#Noun|keyboard]], [[mouse#Noun|mouse]], [[touchscreen#Noun|touchscreen]] or [[paddle#Noun|paddle]]. {{defdate|from 1973}}
#: {{ux|en|My uncle’s favorite '''video game''' is ''{{l|en|Minecraft}}''.}}
#* {{quote-song|en|author=w:Lana Del Rey; w:Justin Parker|title=[[w:Video Games (Lana Del Rey song)|Video Games]]|album=w:Born to Die|date=7 October 2011|artist=Lana Del Rey|passage=Swinging in the backyard / Pull up in your fast car whistling my name / Open up a beer / And you say get over here and play a '''video game''' / {{...}} / I say you the bestest / Lean in for a big kiss, put his favorite perfume on / Go play your '''video game'''}}
#* {{RQ:NYT|author=Peter Baker|title=In Choosing ‘Epic Fury,’ Trump Names a War and Defines His Presidency|date=2026-03-16|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/16/us/politics/trump-operation-epic-fury-anger.html|passage=For a military operation name, Epic Fury sounds like a '''video game''', which may be apt because that’s the way the Trump White House is marketing this war. Online videos circulated by the administration have portrayed the assault on Iran as if it were the latest installment of “Call of Duty.”}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|rare}} To [[play]] [[#Noun|video game]]s.
#* {{quote-book|en|author=David N. Greenfield|chapter=Ten Things You Can Do to Reduce Your Internet Use|title=Overcoming Internet Addiction|series=''{{w|For Dummies}}''|publisher=[[w:Wiley (publisher)|John Wiley & Sons, Inc.]]|year=2021|section=part 5 (The Part of Tens)|page=296|isbn=978-1-119-71187-2|passage=This is one of the most common scenarios we see in our center — when a teen or young adult wants to finish high school, or more often college, and they are '''video gaming''' 12 hours a day.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|author=Kendall Smith|chapter=Step One: Being There|title=Rookie Father: A Playbook for Men Experiencing Fatherhood for the First Time|publisher=Familius LLC|year=2021|isbn=978-1-64170-573-8|passage=It means you show up. Whether it’s a diaper change, advising your son about girls, patting his back after a tough sports game, or egging him on to stop slacking off while he’s '''video gaming'''.}}
